g.text: How SpatialESS stores spatially plausible communication

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5e6c79

g.text: A sparse radius graph and CSR neighbor directory replace the dense all-pairs distance matrix—without changing the official probability formula.

g.text: Take-home: neighbors stores who can communicate; distances stores how far apart they are; offsets tells C++ where each sender's neighbor list begins and ends.
